purpose: Teach: トヨタ自動車/最年少/サバイバル/プラネタリウム/温存/微細/立て続け/頑丈

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、本気で、絶対、トヨタ自動車、絶対、経営戦略、絶対、研究、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — study Toyota's management strategy seriously. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Weight behind each clause. Leans slightly forward. This is a real ask, not casual advice. Warm undertone beneath the direction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。同社、本気で、絶対、最年少、絶対、取締役の、絶対、論文、絶対、拝読いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already read the youngest director's papers from that company. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine — not stiff. Slight breath before 'already' to show he'd anticipated this. Quiet pride in the detail without bragging. Eye contact steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、サバイバル、絶対、競争、絶対、研究しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look into how the industry survives in competition. Study that carefully.
lines.style: Firmer now. Short declarative rhythm. Sits back slightly — this isn't negotiable. The teacher shifting into the part that matters. Still not harsh, just clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。プラネタリウム、本気で、絶対、企業の、絶対、新規事業、絶対、興味深いです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. The planetarium company's new ventures are particularly interesting to me. I appreciate you pointing me there.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before answering. Shows he's actually considering the suggestion, not just nodding. Soft emphasis on 'interesting' — genuine curiosity. Formal but warm close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、人材、絶対、温存、絶対、戦略、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And think about how we preserve talent through strategy. Consider that.
lines.style: Slight shift in tone — this one's personal, about the company culture. Quieter. Not a bark of instruction but a trust being handed over. Pause before 'consider.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。微細、本気で、絶対、加工技術、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already studied their fine-manufacturing techniques in my research. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Methodical, careful enunciation. Shows the homework is already underway. No stumbling — Ren is prepared. Slight nod in the voice. Respectful close without obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、本気で、絶対、立て続け、絶対、リリース、絶対、戦略、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And their strategy for continuous product releases — study that. Understand how they do it.
lines.style: Final piece of the puzzle. Delivered with quiet authority. Tempo steady but deliberate. Leans back — the mentor settling into his seat. This is the capstone of what he wants Ren to see.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。同社の、本気で、絶対、頑丈、絶対、な品質基準、絶対、参考にいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood, sir. Their quality standards are rigorous, and I'll use them as my reference point moving forward. Thank you.
lines.style: Conclusive without rushing. Ren absorbs and confirms. Slight emphasis on 'rigorous' — he sees what Hiroshi is teaching him. Formal but genuinely humble close. Small nod in the delivery.
